environment.build: Rust 1.100.0-nightly (2026-08-31 toolchain), native x86-64 Linux, optimized dev profile (opt-level 3; debug information disabled), multi_threaded with default features disabled
environment.capture_measurement: Two native runs, 80 consecutive rooms each from seed 384; first 16 excluded as warmup; 3 views, 512x512, one time, RGB/depth/normal/position/semantic/co-visibility; shadows/SSAO/GI enabled; 256 GI rays; static people density 0.25
environment.contention: Existing Gekko training and capture processes remained active; no other local qualification or compiler ran during the measured timing protocol. Device telemetry is board-wide and includes those other processes.
environment.cpu_measurement: 64 measured consecutive rooms, seed 400, 4 separate warmups; one and four preparation futures in flight; production GPU recipe preparation
environment.hardware: an Intel Core i9-12900K (24 logical CPUs) and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition using Vulkan
environment.telemetry: out/release_040/current/timing/device.csv; board-wide counters include other processes, not generator-only utilization

summary.timing_policy: stream_* uses complete wall time including validation, JSONL telemetry and drops while prefetched work advances; legacy scenes_per_second uses only capture spans and may overestimate delivery throughput. Preparation wall stages partition a task lifetime, overlap across rooms, and are not additive with capture wall time. update_phase_seconds classifies event-loop call time by the blocker observed before the call, not CPU/GPU execution. Render diagnostics can overlap and arrive late; not a per-scene GPU accounting partition. No PNG/dataset encoding unless save_samples; GPU utilization measured separately
